description: Loan / mortgage amortization: periodic payment, total interest, payoff date and a yearly or full payment schedule (principal, interest, balance) for any rate, term and payment frequency (monthly, bi-weekly, weekly, quarterly, annual). Extra payments per period show months and interest saved. Fixed-rate, level-payment loans. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/loan-amortization

annualRatePct.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent

schedule.description: Schedule detail (full is capped at 600 rows)

startDate.description: First payment date YYYY-MM-DD (for payoff date)
